'''1151''' was a [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadet]] in the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
As a part of the Clone Youth Brigade aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']] he was involved in a tour of the Jedi star cruiser. He was later present when [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], under the alias "Lucky", sabotaged ''Endurance''. Afterward, Admiral Killian ordered the cadets to go to the escape pods, which they did in groups of four. Subsequently, this clone cadet boarded the escape pod, jettisoning from the damaged ship.<ref name="Death Trap" />
